storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP OnlyFans Bulk Downloader lets you batch-download photos, videos, and chat media from your OnlyFans subscriptions directly to your computer.

How it works: Install the extension, sign in with your email, then follow the guided 4-step workflow. First, configure your download speed in Settings. Then select the creators you want to download from. The extension fetches their posts, builds a download list, and processes everything through a managed queue with progress tracking.

The extension includes smart rate limiting with three presets — Conservative, Balanced, and Aggressive — so you can choose between safety and speed. The download queue supports pause, resume, stop, cancel, and retry. You can run 1 to 8 concurrent downloads.

For quick saves while browsing, the extension also adds download buttons directly on images and videos throughout OnlyFans — including in lightboxes, modals, and chat views.

Key features:
- Bulk download from multiple OnlyFans creators at once
- Download photos, videos, or both — media type filter included
- Chat/DM media download support
- Smart rate limiting with 3 presets (Conservative, Balanced, Aggressive)
- Persistent download queue with pause, resume, stop, cancel, and retry
- Configurable concurrency (1-8 simultaneous downloads)
- In-page download overlay buttons on every image and video
- Lightbox and modal support (PhotoSwipe, dialogs, media viewers)
- Auto-saves to organized OnlyFans/ subfolder
- Step-by-step guided workflow — no technical knowledge needed
- Free trial downloads included

Getting started:
1. Install the extension and sign in with your email
2. Open Settings — verify your OnlyFans login and choose download speed
3. Select Creators — browse your subscriptions and pick who to download from
4. Watch Progress — the queue handles everything with real-time status updates

Sign in with your email to unlock trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited bulk downloading.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How does bulk downloading work?
faq.answer: After setup, select one or more creators from your OnlyFans subscriptions. The extension fetches their posts via the OnlyFans API, extracts all media URLs (photos and videos), and queues them for download. The queue processes files with your chosen rate limit preset.

faq.question: Will this get my OnlyFans account banned?
faq.answer: The extension includes three rate limiter presets specifically designed to reduce risk. The Conservative preset (20-30 files/min) is the safest. We recommend using the Balanced preset (40-50 files/min) as a starting point. The extension also includes random timing jitter to simulate human-like behavior.

faq.question: Can I download from any OnlyFans creator?
faq.answer: You can only download from creators you are actively subscribed to. The extension uses your existing OnlyFans session and only accesses content your account has permission to view.

faq.question: What media types can I download?
faq.answer: Photos (JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF) and videos (MP4, MOV, WebM, and more). You can filter to download only photos, only videos, or all media.

faq.question: Can I download chat/DM media?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension includes dedicated chat selection and chat list pages for browsing and downloading media from your OnlyFans conversations.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: All files automatically save to an OnlyFans subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: Can I pause and resume downloads?
faq.answer: Yes. The download queue supports pause, resume, stop, cancel all, clear finished, and retry cancelled operations. You can also adjust concurrency (1-8 simultaneous downloads) while the queue is running.

faq.question: What are the download speed presets?
faq.answer: Conservative (2-3s delay, 25 req/min — safest), Balanced (1-1.5s delay, 45 req/min — recommended), Aggressive (0.5-1s delay, 70 req/min — fastest but riskiest).

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All downloads happen directly between your browser and the OnlyFans CDN. Extension authentication uses secure OTP — no OnlyFans password is accessed or stored.
